Strategy: Flatten the sweet band by halving its Best Fit penalty, so any residual between thirty and forty-five outranks most other gaps, while the mid penalty still punishes awkward leftovers. This changes ranking inside the band instead of adding a flat bonus, but the halving may over-promote loose fits.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) / 2 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else (-(r - item) - 30 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else -(r - item))) for r in bins]
```
